title: ANDS Studio — AI-assisted drafting
walkthrough:
You open a prose section of the dossier. The panel header shows an eyebrow line in the form "Module 1 · Section 1.2.1" plus an applicability tag, then the section title and a purpose sentence. A boxed note titled "What Health Canada needs here" gives guidance text, format chips (e.g. "Format: PDF", and "Bilingual: EN + FR" where applicable) and a link labeled "Health Canada guidance ↗".

Below, an action bar offers tabs such as "⬆ Upload", "✦ Author in-app", and "⊘ Mark N/A". Choosing "✦ Author in-app" on a section that supports AI drafting reveals a second pair of tabs: "💬 Draft with AI" and "✦ Sample & edit" (the tab group's accessible label is "Drafting mode" — that label itself is not visible on screen). "Draft with AI" opens by default on those sections; sections without AI support show only the sample-and-edit form.

The "Draft with AI" tab opens a chat panel. At the top is this text: "Chat with an AI assistant to draft this document — it will ask for any details it needs instead of leaving blanks. Nothing is saved until you click Use this draft." (with "Use this draft" in bold). The empty thread shows: "Tell it about the submission to get started — it knows what [section title] needs." The input is a two-row text box with the placeholder "e.g. Sponsor is Acme Pharma Inc., contact regulatory@acme.example". A "Send" button sits beside it; it is disabled while the input is empty or a reply is streaming, and its label changes to "Thinking…" during a reply. Pressing Enter sends; the reply streams into an assistant bubble token by token, showing "…" until text arrives, and the thread auto-scrolls.

If the AI backend is not configured, an error notice appears below the chat thread (the pending assistant bubble is left as it is — the notice does not replace it): "AI drafting isn't set up yet (no GROQ_API_KEY). Use the standard \"Author\" button below instead, or ask an admin to configure it." Other errors are shown verbatim in the same notice style.

Once at least one assistant reply exists and streaming has stopped, a button appears under the input: "Use this draft →". While saving it reads "Saving…". Nothing is written to the dossier before this click. On success, a confirmation message is set in the panel's live region — a visually hidden aria-live element, so it is announced by screen readers rather than shown as a visible toast — reading: "[Section title] saved as an AI-assisted draft — provenance is recorded in the audit trail. Use "Review vs Health Canada" under ✦ Sample & edit to check the required elements before filing."

The saved document then appears in the section's attached-documents list (rendered above the action bar) with a 💬 icon, the filename, a size like "41.2 KB", and "md5" followed by the first 8 characters of a checksum and an ellipsis. Next to it is a chip reading "AI-assisted — review before filing"; hovering it shows the tooltip: "Drafted interactively with the AI assistant under your direction. Recorded in the audit trail. Review against the Health Canada guidance before filing." For comparison, documents produced by the template form carry an "authored in-app" chip ("Produced in-app from your entries by a deterministic Health Canada template."), and uploads carry "uploaded" ("Uploaded by your team — content is exactly what you provided."). Each row has a "Download" link.

The alternative "✦ Sample & edit" tab shows a form with this note: "Pre-filled with a realistic sample from your dossier — edit every field to your product, then author. Fields marked sample are worked examples to replace." Its buttons are "Author [section title] →" (showing "Authoring…" while busy) and "Review vs Health Canada". The review result renders as "Health Canada review: no blocking content gaps." or "Health Canada review: N to fix, M to check." with a list of findings — each marked ✗ (to fix) or ⚠ (to check) — with a suggested edit and, when the finding carries a guidance URL, an "HC guidance ↗" link.

On the Help page (headed "Regulatory reference"; its top bar reads "ANDS Studio · regulatory reference" with chips linking to "Dossier manager", "Portfolio", "Registry", "Correspondence", and "Guided journey →"), a section titled "How AI drafting is controlled" lists four bullets: "Opt-in, per section — only sections marked ✦AI offer it, and the standard template author is always available instead."; "Nothing is saved until you click Use this draft; the assistant asks for missing facts rather than inventing them."; "Every AI-assisted document is permanently labeled (AI-assisted — review before filing) and recorded as such in the append-only audit trail — provenance never disappears."; and "Drafts go through the same Health Canada content review and eCTD validation as any other document, and the human review + e-signature gate still stands between any document and transmission."
